page.title: Fund and withdraw
page.purpose: Create a receive intent, inspect its exact Base payment request, and allocate only after Treasury confirms a matching transfer; withdrawals require an allowlisted destination and preview.

priorities.statement: The page states that its funding flow is for a disposable local fork and does not authorize customer deposits
The receive intent keeps exact token atoms separate from operator-declared valuation
The payment request is shown as a scannable QR and exact copyable or openable URI
Receipt confirmation is described as the condition for budget allocation
Withdrawals require an allowlisted destination and expose fee and execution-mode details before execution
